analysis: Text-only qualitative and quantitative error analysis; no visual truth assessment

matching_method.unit: per-image occurrence, not token count; each concept may have multiple assertion states
matching_method.affirmative: regex match without detected negation or possibility wording in its clause
matching_method.negation: no/not/without/lack/absent/neither before match in sentence/semicolon/but-separated clause; coordinated lists share scope; explicit not-visible suffix also excluded; postposed not-visible negation also covers coordinated feature lists, e.g. concentric rings or target-like patterns are not clearly visible.
matching_method.uncertainty: possible/possibly/may/might/perhaps/uncertain/unclear in match or preceding eight words; excluded from affirmative counts
matching_method.weak_visible_adjectives: faint/slight/subtle are retained as qualified affirmative wording, not biological truth
matching_method.retention: primary numerator is same image with affirmative detail evidence AND affirmative summary evidence; denominator affirmative detail evidence. Any-mention retention includes negated/not-visible wording and is secondary only.
matching_method.matching_limits: Conservative lexical windows do not resolve all coreference or synonyms. Vein association counts an explicit vein/midrib/interveinal reference; it does not infer a disease-specific relation. Large/irregular lesion/blotch groups either adjective, not both. No concept is inferred from class labels.
matching_method.retention_qualification: Yellow-halo retention requires the yellow qualifier; replacement by pale halo is recorded as loss of that color-specific information, not necessarily loss of the halo concept.

qualitative_inspection.textual_observation: Both classes repeatedly share dark/brown lesions, yellowing, pale centers/dark margins and curling. V2 summaries name pale centers in 7/10 BS versus 5/10 SP, so this source discriminator is not class-exclusive in these generated texts. Circular/round spots are unmentioned in all 10 SP summaries.
qualitative_inspection.causal_limit: These associations are consistent with overlap, not proof that a phrase caused a particular embedding prediction.

qualitative_inspection.textual_observation: Yellow/green discoloration and curling are shared. Mottling/mosaic wording occurs affirmatively in 3/10 LM and 5/10 MV summaries; vein references also occur in both classes (2 LM, 2 MV). No LM summary affirms velvety/surface growth. Thus neither mottling nor generic yellowing separates these classes reliably in the text.

representative_selection_rule: Lowest neutral ID in each V2 confusion direction for each predefined pair; then lowest unused two IDs per disagreement group. No performance/wording-based selection.

limitations: Lexical associations cannot establish why a frozen embedding predicts a class.
Not mentioned or textually negated/not visible does not establish biological absence.
GPT observations were not checked against images; summary-only assertions are text discrepancies, not proven hallucinations.
Correct/incorrect groups have different class composition; frequencies are confounded by class mix.
60 source-side images; no generalization or significance claim; no method selection/tuning.

disagreement_interpretation.only_v1_correct: 12 images. V2 introduces pale-center wording in 9/12 summaries versus 1/12 V1 descriptions, and dark-border wording in 10/12 versus 0/12. Added lesion-structure specificity therefore is not uniformly helpful. Vein references fall from 2/12 to 0/12. Mean lengths increase from 25.5 to 40.67 words.
disagreement_interpretation.only_v2_correct: 13 images. V2 adds some lesion-center/border distinctions (4/13 and 3/13 versus 0/13 and 0/13 in V1), and explicit mottling wording in two images; other gains occur with no specific lesion structure. Mean lengths increase from 25.92 to 38.85 words. These mixed changes do not isolate a color, lesion-structure or compression benefit.
disagreement_interpretation.limit: Summary is compression of the five structured fields, not necessarily shorter than V1. V1 and V2 are separate GPT generations; lexical differences cannot isolate compression causally.

text_information_retention_conclusion.conclusion: Selective omission occurs, especially yellow-halo color specificity (1/6 retained) and some vein association (6/7). Pale/gray-center information is mostly retained (23/25); dark margins 21/21. Rings and surface growth have no affirmative detailed-field evidence, so an affirmative retention rate cannot be computed.
text_information_retention_conclusion.not_generalized_compression_failure: Several discriminators are already absent or textually not visible in the detailed generation; summary-only compression cannot explain all confusion. Some summary assertions do not have matching affirmative detailed-field wording; these are textual differences, not validated hallucinations.
hypotheses_only: Loss of qualifier-specific halo and location information may reduce discriminative detail for some cases; preserving such text information could help, but this requires independent confirmation.

Repeated generic lesion/color/curling and negated-feature wording shared across classes may dominate similarity even when lesion-internal details are retained; text overlap, not retention alone, may limit discrimination.
